about: The states whose law requires 340B reports, grouped by what the public can see. This is a small copy made by hand for the tests of the server.

groups.label: Each filer's own report is posted
groups.description: The state posts the report each covered entity files, one report for each filer.

groups.label: One state report with a figure for each named entity
groups.description: The state publishes one report that gives a figure for each entity it names.

groups.label: One state report with totals only
groups.description: The state publishes one report with statewide totals and no figure for any one entity.

groups.label: Reports are required, none is public yet
groups.description: The law requires reports and no report has been made public so far.
